up: Retrieve all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4613209. For each compound, return the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), maximum clinical phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES string (canonical_smiles).
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4613209';
